intro: Experience pure and healthy drinking water with this premium RO + UV water purifier. Equipped with UV e-Boiling Technology, it delivers water as safe as water boiled for over 20 minutes, while Active Copper Technology enriches every glass with copper ions. The durable 304-grade stainless steel storage tank ensures hygienic storage and long-lasting performance. Featuring a Zero Pressure Pump, smart LED indicators, energy-saving mode, and a sleek modern design, it is an ideal solution for homes using municipal, borewell, or tanker water.
